question: What will be the ending value of the ICE BofA US High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread for these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: Latest FRED value is 3.43 (Nov 17); spreads have been between 3.14 and 3.48 since early October, after widening from ~2.65 in September. The CCC tier has blown out while BB/B are contained. With 13 trading days to Dec 4, I start from the current level, shift the median slightly lower (~3.37) because the series has been mean-reverting around 3.3-3.4 and futures were up Nov 18, and skew the tails upward since spreads widen faster than they tighten. About 11% is put on closing above 3.745 (+32bp, comparable to the late-Sept move). No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market was found.
